target: Compute actual neutral resonance parents and daughter populations, charged returns, inverse reactions, momentum distributions and occupation forces.

results: All physical tree FFS and SSS vertices are included; twelve charged Goldstones are removed and signed lifting is available.
The per-daughter four-state Gamma matrices in the CT09 basis reproduce the prior pole Gamma with maximum error 4.963e-24.

Global two-angle warm RHS errors of 30-40% and soft saturation are finite angular artifacts. Analytic angular moments agree with independent segmented GL32 to about 1e-15; directional Jacobian errors are about 1e-10.

The vectorized and reference builders are bit-for-bit equivalent. An eight-phase backend takes about 0.30 seconds to build, 0.17 seconds per RHS and 0.40 seconds per Jacobian here, with measured peak RSS 558 MB.

The one-period exact direct runs with 128 and 256 steps differ in charged fraction by 4.04e-9. The exact eight-phase averaged comparison has charged relative error 1.176e-6, U1 yield error 5.09e-8, U1 weighted shape error 2.13e-7 and action endpoint error 2.00e-5.

The exact-pole coherent unit pulse retains about 92.3% of its energy in massive neutral particles at tau=3e12. Its momentum-resolved force is -1.747e-4 per initial parent. Neutral does not imply radiation.

At x=3, low B3 ultimately returns about 1.8573 charged carriers per parent. A3 stable at x=3 reopens charged decays near the inner x=.18 part of the orbit. An early charged deficit is partly stored neutral population.
limits: Exact angular integration refers to the finite entropy and energy projection, not the momentum continuum. The tested early GL40 grid has minimum q=.0019855 and maximum q<80.
Near the ordering crossing, weighted forward omission reaches about 2e-5. Arbitrary hard-bath inverse omission is not bounded; late hard neutral particles require a separate momentum range.
Broken-vector widths are omitted. The early vector-open parent energy fraction of at most 8.27e-4 is a population diagnostic, not an omitted-rate bound.
The warm fourfold singlet group is diagonal. The memory package separately uses the coherent late channel matrices and the actual neutral transfer operator.
Gauge 2-to-2 reactions, bound-state formation, adjoint loop decays, full thermal self energies and complete gravitational pole retuning remain outside this package.
The corrected warm bridge is a conditional restart from an old two-angle checkpoint. A fresh corrected cosmology must start from the initial packet.
